author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI can build a 8086 from scratch, but it is really struggling building a 286, no matter how much I yell at it.
The AI got 286 real mode working, but it seems it can't figure out how to implement protection mode.
I have burnt enough tokens on it that I am considering maybe I should wait for GPT-7 or Opus-6 before trying again.

comments.text: 286 protected mode is cursed. The LLM's are saving you from yourself.
